reviews.text:
The vet was very kind.

They also offer shampoo and grooming services for cats.

I was supposed to get eye medication prescribed, but they completely forgot to give it to me and it wasn't included in the bill. Also, I had requested paw pad trimming and nail trimming for both of my cats, but they forgot, or they said they had done it when I picked them up, but the nails hadn't been trimmed at all and my cat got injured... To top it all off, the carrier lining was missing. How many things do they have to forget? Are they even competent? I can't entrust my pets to a hospital with such sloppy management. Is this hospital careless with cats? Are they only for dogs? That's how bad it is. I can't believe something like that should happen. I've never seen a hospital with such terrible service that can't even do a simple nail trim properly. I will never use them again. I recommend that anyone leaving their cats at a different hospital.
For my dog's medical treatment, they keep thorough records of past diagnoses and provide honest and reliable care.

I have multiple cats, and whenever one of them gets sick, they always adjust their schedules to see them, which is incredibly helpful. They've saved my cats' lives many times when they were ill. When I'm unsure whether I should have my cat examined, I can consult with them via their official LINE account, which allows me to act quickly and ensure minimally stressful treatment.

My cats are always treated with such affection by the staff during examinations and checkups that they're not afraid at all and have become quite attached to them (laughs).
The nurses and groomers in the treatment room always say "They're so cute!" and hold and pet them a lot, which shows how much they truly love animals.

They also suggested the least stressful palliative care options for my elderly cat, and even sent fresh flowers after she passed away, showing so much thoughtfulness. I truly feel that choosing this hospital was the right decision.
They always examine me carefully and thoroughly. Also, I really appreciate their quick and flexible response in emergencies.

Despite explaining that my cat's condition was an emergency, they had a terrible attitude, saying they couldn't see her outside of their regular hours.
They were the worst doctors and hospital I've ever encountered.
Our dogs were taken care of at your clinic ✨ We are always grateful to Dr. Kuki and his wife and all the staff for their warmth, and we look forward to your continued support.

We always rely on this veterinary clinic for our dog.

I think the doctor is very trustworthy.

He had underlying illnesses and was cared for at Brown Nursery for a year and four months. They looked after him with sincerity and dedication, and although he passed away, I have no regrets. If he had not been cared for here, he would not have lived such a long life. I am truly grateful. Thank you very much.

My dog ​​has always been taken care of here. He was originally very cautious and was scared of the veterinary clinic at first, but now he loves the kind and polite staff and is very happy to go to hotels and daycare centers, so it's a great help.

They saved my beloved dog's life.

Until then, I had been going to a well-known animal hospital nearby (which has even been featured on TV), but my dog's condition didn't improve, so I sought a second opinion here.

And then, immediately, his condition improved. I am truly grateful.
Everyone is kind, it's a great place.
The atmosphere of the hospital is good and the doctors are very attentive, so I feel at ease. It's also convenient that the hospital is open from early in the morning until late at night.
